title: Crispy Pesto Potatoes with Green Beans
summary: Golden roasted potatoes are tossed with tender green beans and a bright basil pesto for a simple Italian-inspired vegetarian dinner. It is crisp, herby and satisfying, especially with a little parmesan-style richness from the pesto.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Put the potato chunks in a pan of salted boiling water and simmer for 8 minutes, until just tender at the edges but not falling apart.
Drain the potatoes well, then return them to the hot pan for 1 minute to steam dry. Shake the pan gently to rough up the edges; this helps them crisp.

Tip the potatoes onto a baking tray. Toss with the olive oil, 0.5 tsp salt and the black pepper, then spread out in a single layer. Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until deeply golden and crisp on the outside.
Meanwhile, cook the green beans in boiling water for 3–4 minutes, until bright green and tender-crisp. Drain and rinse briefly under cold water to stop them overcooking.
Stir the pesto with the grated garlic and lemon juice in a large bowl. Add the hot crispy potatoes and green beans, then toss gently until everything is coated.
Taste and add the remaining salt if needed. Serve immediately, scattered with grated parmesan.
